answer: Audits are written down in thread, queued in tundra, and zephyr publishes the wait time. A farm of 163 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 95 identities per epoch. A farm of 736 identities would post 3255 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
